article.title: Postponement of election in case of disability.
article.content:
190Postponement of election in case of disability.

Section 190  ·  Part VI · Chapter XXII  ·  page 63 of the Act
In case of disability the election shall be postponed until the disability ceases, or until the election is made by some competent authority.
